title: Staff say jobs are moving offshore as NAB sheds workers
byline: Alex Turner-Cohen; Katie Silver; Bronwyn Herbert
paragraphs: Entire teams of National Australia Bank workers are having to reapply for their jobs and compete among themselves as part of a major restructure.
Staff say the writing was on the wall as they witnessed the bank pushing to offshore workers and take up AI.
The major bank revealed plans to slash 2,500 roles by June next year, with 1,500 expected to be out the door before Christmas.
